title: Quiver varieties and dual canonical bases
summary: We survey some recent developments on the theory of dual canonical bases for quantum groups and $\imath$quantum groups. The $\imath$quiver algebras were introduced by Wang and the first author, which are used to give two realizations of quasi-split $\imath$quantum groups of type ADE: one via the $\imath$Hall algebras and the other via the quantum Grothendieck rings of Nakajima-Keller-Scherotzke quiver varieties. The geometric construction of the $\imath$quantum groups produces their dual canonical bases with positivity, generalizing Qin's geometric realization of quantum groups of type ADE.…
